meta.title: Reply Timer
meta.description: A live timer under the composer: elapsed time, current stage and tool count, with stall detection driven by the host's real output frames (warns after 20s with no output). On completion it prints a first-token / tool / generation ledger plus a reference range learned from similar past turns (only shown with enough samples, never a fake countdown). Durations and history are persisted by the host, so they survive a page refresh and an app restart.
